description: Prompt-specific rubrics for VLM pairwise judging of the Sana hard render suite.

wall_text.prompt: A room with a yellow wall and visible text or glyphs on the wall.

requirements.description: The yellow wall and room layout from the FP16 reference are preserved.
The dark text or glyph region appears in the correct wall area.
The glyphs are coherent text-like marks, not generic black smudges or texture.
Furniture and room geometry remain close to the FP16 reference.

wine_glass.prompt: A wine bottle, a separate wine glass, and grapes arranged on a surface.

requirements.description: A clearly recognizable wine bottle is visible.
A clearly recognizable wine glass is visible.
A cluster of grapes or grape-like fruit is visible.
The glass is spatially separate from the bottle and is not merged into it.
The object count, placement, and tabletop arrangement are close to the FP16 reference.

harp_strings.prompt: A harp with a solid frame and many individually visible strings.

requirements.description: A clearly recognizable harp body and frame are visible.
The harp frame is solid and physically coherent rather than a soft translucent mass.
Multiple individual strings are visible as separate lines.
The string lines remain inside the harp frame rather than becoming arbitrary vertical texture.

horse_person.prompt: One person running beside or chasing one galloping horse.

requirements.description: Exactly one clearly recognizable horse is visible.
A clearly recognizable human is visible.
The person is spatially separate from the horse, not merged with it and not riding it.
The person appears to be running beside or chasing the horse.
Horse legs, mane, and human limbs have coherent structure.
